author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I find it very hard to work with engineers who don't use AI.

When I ask my AI writes a detail bug report and send it to another AI-native engineer, he will simply tell his AI to look at my bug report, test it and get new info back to my AI.  Then we align the findings on human channel, loop until the two AI eventually fixed the bug or concluded that it is indeed a feature.

When my AI sends the bug report to a non-AI engineer, he says the report is too long, he asks me to explain to him in human language where exactly the bug is and wants me to convince him that it is indeed a bug as a human.

I will just bypass that guy and fix the bug myself together with my AI.

comments.text: "give me the answer in 5 sentences max" is a phrase i use a lot these days. Saves some tokens too.
